title: game-totals-2026-09-13
universal_lens: A snapshot-consensus operator maps live multi-book lines to a canonical game state via (total + spread)/2 implied totals, with staleness detection flagging opener drift and variance thresholds triggering alternate-model branches for pace simulation.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian posterior over game totals combines live-board likelihoods (AN, Covers, official) with prior opener distribution; conformal prediction sets widen when book variance >1 point (TB@CIN 49.5 vs 50.5), producing calibrated pace-model inputs with explicit alternate branches.
gse_mapping: State-transition kernel ingests timestamped line snapshots (12:00-12:40 CT) as observations; transition from opener to current total (48.5→47.5 DAL@NYG) triggers regime flag; implied-total derivation (28.25, 28.5) feeds situational offense/defense rate estimators for drive-level simulation.

primitives.name: Implied Team Total Derivation
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | 4 | Detroit Lions implied team total 28.25 (NO@DET) | **CONFIRMED** | **28.25** | Derivation from verified inputs: (game total 49.5 + spread 7) / 2 = 28.25 (AN: total 49.5, spread DET -7).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: T_game: game total (points, dimensionless count); S: point spread (points, favorite negative by convention but added algebraically); T_implied: implied team total (points). All dimensionless counts.
primitives.assumptions: Spread and total from same book/snapshot; favorite covers exactly half the spread on average; no vigorish adjustment; linear superposition holds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks when spread/total from mismatched books (DET -7.5/50 vs -7/49.5 yields 28.25-28.5 range); fails for underdog implied total without sign flip; invalid if line moves between total and spread fetch.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE drive-rate estimator: implied total / expected drives = points per drive prior; feeds GSI Bayesian offense/defense rating update as likelihood center.
layer2.telemetry: RMSE between implied total and actual team points scored; book-pair spread/total consistency delta.

primitives.name: Live-Board Snapshot Consensus
primitives.verbatim_quote: 51.1 does not match any current board; the total opened higher (~52.5) and settled at 50.5/49.5.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: T_AN, T_Covers, T_official: game totals from each source at snapshot timestamp t_snap (points); T_canonical: consensus total (points).
primitives.assumptions: Sources are independent; snapshot timestamp synchronized across sources; mode/median robust to single outliers; banned sources excluded.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when sources disagree >1 point (TB@CIN 49.5 vs 50.5); fails if snapshot stale relative to kickoff; fails if AN board shows different vig without total change.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE observation operator: multi-sensor fusion at fixed time yields state estimate; variance across sensors sets conformal prediction width for GSI pace model.
layer2.telemetry: Inter-source absolute deviation; timestamp drift vs kickoff; consensus stability across consecutive snapshots.

primitives.name: Book Variance & Alternate Branch Flag
primitives.verbatim_quote: - TB@CIN has the widest book variance: 49.5 (Covers) vs 50.5 (AN, iHeart).
primitives.latex: \Delta T = \max_i T_i - \min_i T_i; \quad \text{if } \Delta T > 1.0 \rightarrow \text{flag alternate branch}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: T_i: game total from source i (points); ΔT: max-min spread across sources (points); threshold 1.0 point.
primitives.assumptions: Variance >1 point indicates genuine market disagreement not vig difference; alternate branch (50.5 primary, 49.5 alternate) captures bimodality; pace model must ingest both.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if variance driven by one stale source; fails if threshold too low (noise) or too high (missed bimodality); breaks when only two sources exist (no majority).

layer2.mapping: GSI: mixture-model prior with weights from source reliability; GSE: regime-switching state transition where ΔT>1 triggers dual-scenario simulation with probability split.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of ΔT>1 across weeks; calibration of alternate-branch hit rate; Brier score of mixture vs single forecast.

primitives.name: Opener-to-Snapshot Staleness Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: Use 47.5 as the Sept 13 snapshot; the 48.5 number seen earlier in the week is stale.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: T_current: total at snapshot; T_opener: opening total; t_snap, t_opener: timestamps (hours); τ: staleness threshold (hours, context-dependent).
primitives.assumptions: Line movement is monotonic information incorporation; opener reflects pre-week information only; snapshot reflects all public info up to t_snap; τ ~ 24-48 hours for NFL.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if late injury news moves line after snapshot; fails if opener re-posted (re-opener); fails for games with no early opener (primetime).

layer2.mapping: GSE: state-transition timestamp check — if observation age > τ, discard prior; GSI: prior weight decay exponential in (t_snap - t_opener) for Bayesian update.
layer2.telemetry: Mean absolute opener-to-close movement; correlation of movement direction with game outcome; staleness-flag hit rate.

reasoning_traces.think:
The verification document reveals a measurement pipeline: (1) fetch live boards at fixed snapshot (12:00-12:40 CT), (2) compute implied team totals via (total+spread)/2 for favorites, (3) cross-source consensus with mode/median, (4) flag variance >1pt as alternate branches, (5) discard opener if stale. The implied-total operator is a linear projection from the 2D (total, spread) market manifold to 1D team scoring expectation. Its Jacobian is [1/2, 1/2], so errors in total and spread propagate equally. Book variance (TB@CIN 49.5 vs 50.5) creates a bimodal likelihood — the pace model must run dual scenarios (50.5 primary, 49.5 alternate) rather than averaging. Staleness detection (DAL@NYG 48.5→47.5) is a temporal filter: opener weight decays as exp(-(t_snap-t_opener)/τ). Failure modes: mismatched book spread/total pairs (DET -7.5/50 vs -7/49.5) widen implied-total range 28.25-28.5; single-source variance indistinguishable from vig; snapshot timing drift relative to kickoff injects look-ahead bias if not frozen.

reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity: implied total and game total share 50% variance — never use both as independent features. Leakage veto: snapshot must be strictly pre-kickoff; any post-kickoff line movement (live betting) contaminates pace prior. Variance flag ΔT>1 must not trigger on vig-only differences (same total, different juice). Staleness threshold τ must be calibrated per week, not fixed, to avoid discarding valid openers in low-movement weeks.
